comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove S rules from Ruff until existing violations are fixed**

Adding `"S"` to Ruff’s global `select` list immediately turns existing security-style findings into hard lint failures, which breaks the default CI lint gate (`.github/workflows/ci-standard.yml` runs `ruff check .`). On this commit, `ruff check .` reports dozens of `S*` errors (e.g., `S603`, `S607`, `S108`) in untouched files, so unrelated PRs will fail until a large repo-wide cleanup happens. This should be introduced only with staged ignores or alongside remediation.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
